name: Muthoot Microfin Ltd
title: Muthoot Microfin Ltd - 544055 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Muthoot Microfin is pivoting from monoline JLG to diversified retail: FY26 AUM ₹14,005 cr (+13%), GNPA 3.89%, credit cost 3.5%, and a ₹30,000 cr AUM by 2030 target needing ~21% CAGR.

triggers.label: Cost of funds 11.02% → 10.27%
triggers.quote: We had a cost of fund of 11.02%. That cost of fund has come down to 10.27%, and it is further likely to come.

triggers.label: Collection efficiency 93% → 96.4%
triggers.quote: The collection efficiency which was around 93% has gone to around 96.4% overall.

triggers.label: Q4 disbursements ₹2,876 cr, +46% YoY
triggers.quote: we have disbursed around INR2,876 crores, which is almost 46% growth year-on-year

triggers.label: FY27 AUM growth 12–15% guided
triggers.quote: Yesterday in your presentation, your AUM growth for FY27 was 12% to 15%.

guidance.quote: Yesterday in your presentation, your AUM growth for FY27 was 12% to 15%.
Muthoot Microfin is aiming to reach INR30,000 crores AUM by 2030.
consistently delivering a ROA of 5% and above, ROE of 20% and above
we are looking at 13.5% to 14% NIM expanding.
we are likely to be 5% and below by 2030 in terms of our , sorry, operating cost.
Around four times leverage is what the company is comfortable at a balance sheet level.

prior_guidance_check.quote: In terms of AUM growth that we had guided for around 5% to 10%, we are at 13%.
the credit cost that we had guided 4% to 6%, we are much below that at 3.5%.
in terms of our diversification strategy that we were talking 85% to 15%, we are at 83% to 17%.

red_flags.label: Aggressive 2030 CAGR of ~21% vs 12–15% FY27 guide
red_flags.quote: your AUM growth for FY27 was 12% to 15%. Now, if you take 12% to 15% growth for FY 27, the remaining three years you have to grow at a CAGR of around 23%.

red_flags.label: Management says guardrail rejection rate ~60%, borrower pool thin
red_flags.quote: We are having a rejection rate of RSI of 60% collectively

red_flags.label: Yield uplift claimed while credit cost falls; analyst challenge unanswered
red_flags.quote: when your yields actually go up, the ability of the portfolio to perform better on credit cost usually does not happen.

evasions.quote: The yield is not increasing merely by increasing the rates.
CGFMU is waiting for a new budget allocation for taking up the new applications.
